question: Which of the following plant hormones helps in the growth of plant stems?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gibberellin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Gibberellin** is a plant hormone that regulates growth and influences various developmental processes, including stem elongation.
 
• It plays a crucial role in the elongation of cells in plant stems, leading to increased plant height.
 
• Gibberellins are involved in breaking seed dormancy and promoting germination.
 
• They also facilitate flowering and fruiting, influencing the maturation of fruits and flowers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Abscisic Acid (ABA)**

 
 
• Abscisic acid is a plant hormone that primarily acts as a growth inhibitor.
 
• It plays a significant role in seed dormancy and helps plants respond to stress conditions such as drought.
 
• ABA is involved in the closing of stomata to prevent water loss in plants.
 
 
 
• **Cytokinin**
 
 
• Cytokinins are a class of plant hormones that promote cell division and growth.
 
• They are involved in the regulation of cell differentiation and delay the aging of leaves.
 
• Cytokinins work in conjunction with auxins to control various aspects of plant growth and development.
 
 
 
• **Ethylene**
 
 
• Ethylene is a gaseous plant hormone that influences fruit ripening and leaf abscission.
 
• It plays a role in the response to mechanical stress and aids in the regulation of plant growth.
 
• Ethylene is also involved in the senescence (aging) process of plants.
